assetProduction.definition: First authored procedural model/texture recipe edit through frozen geometry/appearance source and provenance hash; excludes animation implementation and validation afterwards.

limitations: No WebGL pixels, real-device performance, or visual acceptance captured.
Imported CC0 GLBs remain available with original provenance; authored actor models are a separate source-based asset family.
Stylized authored mesh surfaces use rigid single-joint weights and low-cost material microstructure, not scanned photorealistic characters or facial performance.
Contacts are presentation-only two-bone sagittal IK on a bounded +/-0.18 local height neighborhood, not full-body physics, obstacle collision, or terrain-normal foot alignment.
Cadence is tied to distance only inside continuous locomotion; on speed/motion transitions the stride is not persistent world-space foot locking.
Live hit recoil inferred from observed HP decrease is visual-only; unseen past hits do not replay on load. Combat action phases still follow saved gameplay timers.
No production gameplay rules, movement, damage, save schema, or imported CC0 asset bytes changed.

rework.changes: Reduced initial per-joint draw submission (32–51 meshes humans / 38 wolf) by binding authored surfaces to bones and merging skin geometry per material.

Corrected unreachable long-stride ankle targets by lowering pelvis; normalized phase to actor scale and wolf stance fraction; guards for non-player spear state; grounded corpse limbs/capes; separate archer recovery pose.

First formal focused run 9/11: ambiguous material-name lookup in test fixture and identical archer release/recovery. Next 10/11: fixed overstrict patient absolute pivot-height assertion to scale-normalized adult skeletal proportion. Final 11/11. Exploratory numerical probes also drove the contact/corpse corrections listed above.

implementation.definition: Motion controller, semantic timer mapping, focused tests, and local corrective passes after the geometry recipe was frozen; includes test/rework time, does not overlap assetProduction.
